sources.text:
Cincar (Serbian Cyrillic: Цинцар) is a mountain in the Dinaric Alps of western Bosnia and Herzegovina, located at 43°54′08″N 17°03′46″E
between Livno, Kupres and Glamoč. The highest point, the Cincar peak, is at an elevation of 2,006 m (6,581 ft).


== References ==


== Bibliography ==
